review: R10 round 28, safety lens (independent; strict real-errors-only rule)

findings.title: FMEA's current R10 disposition row says the bus / continuity dividers keep 'ADC series protection'; R10 has none (R168 / R170 removed by audit 2, PC0 / PC5 read the divider nodes directly)
contradicts: The board: PYRO1_CONT and ARM1_SENSE end directly on U1.15 (PC0) and U1.33 (PC5); no ADC series part exists.

REQUIREMENTS.md F8 (line 62): 'continuity PYRO1_CONT PC0 directly read filtered 10.2 kOhm/1 kOhm dividers ... Delete duplicate RAW_ACT_SENSE/PB0 and R168 / R170 4.7 kOhm tails ... Double faults can damage the MCU; no double-fault current guarantee.'

FMEA_REDUNDANCY.md's own R10 circuit amendment (lines 3-8): 'Both filtered nodes connect directly to the MCU: R168 / R170 and the duplicate bank are removed ... The historical double-fault 9.4 mA limit is withdrawn; double faults can damage the MCU.'
M3_R10.md lines 584-585 (CH1 pyro): 'ARM1_SENSE directly feeds PC5 and PYRO1_CONT directly feeds PC0; audit 2 removes R168 / R170.'
tools/check_r10.py mcu_side_issues (S-1, line 1921) fails any 'obsolete MCU-side sense tail; connect the filtered node directly to PC0 / PC5'.

The FMEA's own vocabulary: 'ADC series protection' is the 4.7 kOhm pin resistor layer, listed separately from 'split sense dividers' in the R6-R9 row (line 80) and described in I-9 (line 115) as 'Second layer, passes 9-10: R168-R171, 4.7 kOhm between each divider node and its ADC pin'.

evidence.statement: docs/FMEA_REDUNDANCY.md:39, row 'I-1 / I-2 / I-5; H-1 / H-2; T-3 / T-4' of the table under '## R10 applicability: one screw switch' (column 'Current R10 disposition'): 'Keep R134 2 Ohm, Q124's pull-down / series resistor / gate-source capacitor, reset-safe gate, cold pull-up and bus / continuity dividers with ADC series protection.'
evidence.board: pcbnew (KiCad 10 Python, read-only) on the committed PCB a0ec075e: PYRO1_CONT = {C127.1, R129.2, R130.1, R178.1, U1.15}; ARM1_SENSE = {C129.1, R133.1, R175.2, R180.1, U1.33}; R168, R170 and R172 are absent from the 216 footprints. PYRO1_CONT copper runs U1.15 -> F.Cu (24.0,50.55)-(24.0,52.15) -> via (24.0,52.15) -> B.Cu to C127.1 / R129.2 / R130.1 / R178.1 with no series part.
evidence.history: git log -S: the phrase was written in 73af96b (2026-10-28, single screw-switch pass) while R168 / R170 were still fitted (they are in 8bccb07's netlist); audit 2 (ff15523, 2026-10-29) removed them; the FMEA header was amended in 6628488 (round 19) but row 39 kept the old phrase. Not in any round 24-27 triage observation (grep 'series protection' / 'ADC series' over sources/r10_review).

findings.impact: The FMEA's current disposition for the I-1 / I-2 / I-5 class credits PC0 / PC5 with the I-9 'second layer' that limits pin current under a double fault. R10 withdrew that layer (double faults can damage the MCU), so this row overstates the sense-pin protection that a reviewer or the owner reads as current. No board change; no new fire path (the single-resistor rule, <= 3.342171 V at 19.9 V, still holds).
findings.concrete_fix: docs/FMEA_REDUNDANCY.md:39: replace 'and bus / continuity dividers with ADC series protection' with 'and the bus / continuity dividers (two 5.1 kOhm tops, two 2 kOhm bottoms, 10 nF) read directly by PC0 / PC5: audit 2 removed the 4.7 kOhm ADC series resistors R168 / R170, so one resistor fault stays within the pin ratings (<= 3.342171 V at 19.9 V) but there is no double-fault current limit (REQUIREMENTS F8)'. Text only.

observations: VLOGIC onto 3V3 (the I-5 mechanism) on the surface: U2.1 (3V3, AP63203 FB) to U2.2 (VLOGIC, EN) 0.400 mm (B.Cu, adjacent TSOT-26 pins) and C84.1 (VLOGIC) to the 3V3 via (26.4,79.26) 0.531 mm (F.Cu); not named in the I-5 route lists (owner row 1, FMEA I-5 (R10), R10_VALIDATION section 1 (a)). Not counted: round 27's triage ruled that these lists are not claimed complete (PYRO1_IGN-3V3 0.735 mm, RAW_ACT-3V3 0.837 mm).

Owner row 24 quotes ACT_EN_MCU 0.5205 mm and RAW_ACT 0.5008 mm to BAT_ENABLE; exact pcbnew shape distance on a0ec075e is 0.5197 / 0.5000 mm (section 1's table says 0.500). Sub-micron method difference, no consequence.

ORDERING 8.3 per-flight step 2's diagnosis ('A board that is on with J400 open means ...') does not name a U9 IN-OUT short (U9.5-U9.6 0.200 mm, TI land), a switch or J400 contact that is not actually open, or the J1.1 BAT_IN In2 ring 0.2505 mm from In2 RAW_PROTECTED (rounds 20 / 21: not filed). The required action (do not insert the e-match) is unchanged.

M3_R10 Firmware rule 3 and the binding note state '1.19-1.98 V on the gate ... fires the match after about 0.55 ms' without the 'driver resistances are Inference' label that R10_VALIDATION section 1 and FMEA I-2 / H-2 (R10) carry; ORDERING 8.3 labels it 'Calculation'. Conservative direction and labelled at its source (round23_safety_severity_check.md coverage limits); not a false statement.

Single faults that energise RAW_ACT with J400 open by themselves: Q121.4-Q121.9 gate-drain 0.520 mm (RAW_ACT settles about |VGS(th)| below the source), Q121 source-drain 0.520 mm (through Q120's body diode), ACT_DRV and ACT_GATE copper 0.2505 mm from GND fill, and a Q122 gate-drain short (R123 then pulls ACT_GATE to about 50/62 of the source voltage, VGS about -5.4 V). All are in owner row 2's disclosed load-switch class; per-flight step 2 (J121.2 < 0.1 V) screens a pre-existing one; firing still needs Q124.

AGENTS section 2 on the board: 2.1 / 2.2 J400 -> U9 EN, RAW_ACT reached only through Q120 / Q121 (S-2; the R10 reading of 'load switch' recorded in rounds 18 / 19); 2.3 the firmware and per-flight texts keep ground refusals and in-flight never-veto; 2.4 Q124 R128 10 k gate-source, R126 220 Ohm series, C126 220 nF gate-source, R127 1 k at PE4; Q120 / Q121 R119 || R120 50 k, R121 10 k, C120 1 uF; Q122 R123 2 k, R122 1 k, C123 10 nF; all defined off with U1 in reset or unpowered. No violation found.

Every section 1 / owner row 1-2 / FMEA I-5 / M3_R10 deviation figure re-measured on a0ec075e reproduces: OUT-GND 0.1768 / 0.1800, R173.1-Q124 source via 0.500, OUT-BUZZ_DRV 0.7935, OUT-3V3A 1.0400, OUT-3V3 1.0500 (F.Cu) / 1.0511 (B.Cu), gate nets 1.065 / 1.0585 / 1.145, CONT_MID-Q123.1 0.175 (diagonal 0.2005), CONT_MID-R134.2 0.250 (diagonal 0.3862), R173.2-D120.3 0.4154, R173.2-R162.1 1.1328, ARM1_SENSE-U13.5 0.150, RAW_ACT-GND 0.3162 (non-fill), U9.1-BAT_IN 0.200, EN via-BAT_FAULT_N 0.200, R123.1-BAT_ENABLE 0.330, EN via-R134.2 0.500, R81.1-GND via 0.1732, RAW_ACT-R134.1 0.3672, RAW_ACT-R87.1 0.225, J440.1 / J9.1 In2 rings 0.2505 and In2 3V3 fill edges 0.300 mm, BAT_FAULT_N 0.180 / 0.380 mm.

Cold-screen arithmetic reproduces: healthy CONT / BUS 99.370 / 99.339 mV, open 146.226 / 0 mV (Vf 0.2 V); 96.2 / 96.1 and 141.5 mV at Vf 0.30 V; CONT_MID-RAW_ACT bridge with an open match 102.0 / 55.5 mV; OUT-3V3 bridge 0.295 V; CONT_MID-3V3 0.541 V; 'at most about 4.6 V on PC14' is the bound 8.4 x 6.1 / 11.2 V without R163.

D-R26-04's whole-board audit reproduced in the changed regions (x 5-26 / y 45-67 and x 4-11.5 / y 12-25, every net pair, with and without fills, 92c3ad59 vs a0ec075e): exactly the seven (no fills) / six (fills) rows the records list.

Barrels on a0ec075e reproduce S-8: PYRO1_OUT via 1.0209 mm to its GND partner's inner pads, 2.698 mm to In2 3V3; J121.1 1.050 / 1.050 / 1.0612 mm (In2 3V3) and 1.5754 mm to R13's 3V3 via barrel; ACT_GATE and BAT_ENABLE barrels 1.050 mm; PYRO1_GATE via 2.100 mm (In2 USB_LIMITED) and 2.7505 mm (In2 3V3); J121.2 rings 0.2505 mm from GND (exempt).

BAT_SW_SOURCE's via (10.8,69.2) is 0.2505 mm from In2 RAW_PROTECTED and J400.1 keeps In1 / In2 rings 0.2505 mm from GND; BAT_SW_SOURCE is outside BARREL_NETS, and a short there only shifts EN while J400 is closed (no latch once J400 opens) or holds the board off.

AON7524 VGS(th) is 0.4-1.2 V (AOS Rev 1.1 p2), so any 3.3 V logic bridge to Q124's gate nets is a fire command; the only such neighbours within 1.2 mm are QSPI_IO2 (0.550 mm, disclosed), 3V3 / 3V3A (>= 1.0585 mm) and PYRO1_OUT (Q124 G-D 0.520 mm, round 25 observation). BARO_SDO (TP122-R64.1 1.130 mm) is pulled to GND by R64 (fail-safe).
